{{Quote|There are some pretty large tree frogs on Ossus. They've even been known to bring down tee-sixty-five trainers.|Jaina Solo|<ref name="Inf">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>}}
The '''tree frogs''' were a breed of [[Frog/Legends|frog]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. They nested in the trees of the forests near the [[Jedi academy]], and had incredibly long and powerful tongues, the likes of which were known to ground [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65]] trainer craft. They could even pull down a ship as large as [[Dactyl (starship)|StarDrive Dactyls]] if enough frogs attached themselves to the hull via their tongues.<ref name="Inf" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ossus tree frogs were first mentioned in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]'' by [[Troy Denning]]. The creatures, and their capabilities, are discussed in a three-way conversation between characters [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Zekk]] and [[Jagged Fel]].<ref name="Inf" />
